g.text: Preconditions: authenticated platform user has SUPER_ADMIN role.
Provisioning is synchronous. Secrets and raw passwords are never returned or logged.
Submit tenant identity and initial admin credentials
Validate code, subdomain, email, and password
Forward validated security context and request
validate JDBC URL and DB config
Dedicated DB and least-scope user ready
The supplied URL and credentials target only this tenant database.
Roll back admin transaction when active
Do not drop partially created resources or customer data.
A later explicit retry resumes under the same tenant lock.
Show activated tenant and login code
Master registration and tenant provisioning are separate transaction boundaries.
No distributed transaction spans PostgreSQL and MySQL.
